description: tensor_dev_missions.status transition graph (SPEC §4.2 lifecycle formalisation). States are NOT duplicated here: every key/target must be a member of mission_status_vocab.v1.json#statuses, and that equality is machine-checked by backend/tests/test_mission_reopened_state.py plus tools/contracts/vocab_contract_audit.py (item state_machine_closure). The only governance-injected state is REOPENED: it is reachable exclusively from the terminal set, only by an independent governance actor (never the producer of the deliverable), and only when the caller cites the original acceptance record — the rule block below is the single source for both the backend endpoint (api/domain/mission_state_machine.py) and the ops-side guard (ops/taskplane/mission_reopen.py), whose decisions are locked to be identical by test. Words go into this file, never into a code literal.
workable_note: States that carry live execution (queued = claimable by a worker, claimed/running = in a worker's hands). The machine invariant: every edge from a terminal state into this set must be enumerated in audited_retry_edges — i.e. no *undeclared* revival backdoor exists. The formal revival path is terminal -> reopened; the enumerated exemptions are the live `refill` retry (one-step re-dispatch, audited under result.refill), which predates this contract and is listed rather than silently tolerated.

queued.note: claim() takes queued->claimed; suspend/orphan-reaper/stop/revoke are platform-side exits

claimed.note: start() -> running; reclaim/lazy-reap return to queued; stale claim -> failed

awaiting_acceptance.note: approval decides succeeded/failed; rejection refills to queued

awaiting_pr_merge.note: pr-gate merged -> succeeded, closed -> failed; custody-requeue -> queued

succeeded.note: pr-gate open report turns success provisional; closed report -> failed; queued = refill retry (audited exemption)

failed.note: terminal: governance reopen, or refill retry (audited exemption)

stopped.note: terminal: owner stop-payment; reopen needs an independent governance actor, refill retry is the audited exemption

orphan.note: terminal: reaped queued mission; reopen only with cited acceptance record

reopened.note: parked rework state: release -> queued, or governance closes it again

reopen.note: SPEC §4.2: 重开必须引用原验收记录并说明理由，且由独立治理侧（非生产者本人）触发。The ref prefix records WHICH artefact is being cited (dev_acceptance row, review verdict, PR, or evidence bundle).

audited_retry_edges.note: Terminal -> workable edges that exist in the live API but are NOT post-acceptance reopens: POST /tensor/missions/{id}/refill sets status='queued' in one step for succeeded/failed/stopped and audits the act under result.refill (no acceptance citation, no REOPENED anchor). They are enumerated here so the machine checks can assert 'no UNDECLARED terminal->workable backdoor' instead of loosening the rule into a no-op. Recommendation (out of scope for m5022): route refill through reopened + release once the migration is deployed, then delete this exemption.
